newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LIETUVA HOTEL Q1 LOSS RISES SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: LIETUVA HOTEL Q1 LOSS RISES SLIGHTLY.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest hotel the Lietuva Hotel on Monday said its first quarter turnover dipped to 1.7 million litas compared to 2.01 million litas last year and losses rose to 500,000 litas versus 419,000 litas.
Director general of the hotel, Rimantas Jogela, told Reuters that in the winter season the hotel had less visitors, a common problem for big hotels for the first quarter of the year.
"During the second quarter of the year we usually compensate the losses of the three month of the year and make a profit," Jogela said.
He said that in April the hotel was operating at 50 percent of its capacity.
The hotel reported 817,352 litas net profit in 1996 and its turnover was 10.7 million litas.
The government earlier this year slated the hotel for privatisation and formed a comission to negotiate with potential investors last Wednesday.
U.S. company Cambridge Group International has been mentioned among the potential investors by European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene.
She also said that talks with the company may start before the end of the month.
